pr_title: fix(workflow): hide empty option for non-nullable select fields

comments.body: The empty option is now added only when `isNullable` is truthy. `isNullable` is optional and undefined by default, so every caller that doesn't pass it loses the "No value" option. The PR description says it "defaults to the previous behaviour" and describes `isNullable !== false`, but this code does not do that. The callers that don't pass `isNullable` are FormCountrySelectInput.tsx:57, FormCallingCodeSelectInput.tsx:84, FormCurrencyFieldInput.tsx:60, WorkflowEditActionCodeFields.tsx:129, WorkflowEditActionEmailBase.tsx:205, WorkflowEditActionFormFieldSettings.tsx:90 and WorkflowFormFieldSettingsSelect.tsx:85 and :106. Before this change each of them could clear its value; now they can't. FormFieldInput.tsx:124 also passes `field.metadata.isNullable`, which is undefined when the metadata doesn't set it. Fix: use `isNullable !== false`, or pass `isNullable` explicitly from those callers.

The surrounding code reads `field.metadata?.options`, using optional chaining on `metadata`. This line reads `field.metadata.isNullable` without it, which is inconsistent and throws if `metadata` is ever undefined. The PR description says it passes `field.metadata?.isNullable`. Use `field.metadata?.isNullable`.
